search_web_query: search the web using web_search_tool with a query string and optional limit for top results
extract_web_content: extract content from a list of URLs using web_extract_tool with optional LLM summarization and markdown format
crawl_website: crawl a website using web_crawl_tool with depth setting and optional extraction instructions
summarize_web_content: summarize large web content using process_content_with_llm with chunked processing and synthesis for pages over 500k characters
clean_base64_images: clean base64 encoded images from text content to reduce token count and clutter
